scope: Metadata-only local Codex sessions whose recorded CWD is this project, source supervisor(vscode) or subagent. Counts positive changes in cumulative token records inside window; duplicated unchanged records ignored. Does not read or export message content.
limitations: Not an authoritative subscription meter or conversion to weekly-limit percentage.
Excludes experiment exec sessions, other CWDs, missing/unreported calls and work outside the window.
Cached input is part of input; reasoning output is part of output. Do not add either twice.
This aggregate does not assign each supervision turn to scientific gain, infrastructure, reporting or waiting.
